description: This PHP class 'RequestParams' manages and retrieves various types of request parameters (body, attributes, query) for an API, providing typed accessors and handling complex types like Base64 attachments with SVG sanitization.

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: A class that encapsulates retrieval and validation of request parameters (body, attributes, query) for an API, including support for various data types and SVG sanitization.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieve a string parameter from the specified parameter bag, with a default value.

methods.name: getStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve a string parameter that may be null, optionally converting empty strings to null.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieve an integer parameter, throwing an exception if the parameter is an empty string.

methods.name: getIntOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve an integer parameter or null if not present.

methods.name: getFloatOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve a float parameter or null if not present.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieve a boolean parameter with a default value.

methods.name: getBooleanOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve a boolean parameter or null if not present.

methods.name: getArrayOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve an array parameter or null if not present.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieve a Base64-encoded attachment object from the request.

methods.name: getAttachmentOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve a Base64 attachment or null, with SVG sanitization if applicable.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieve a DateTime object from the request parameters, with optional timezone conversion.

methods.name: getDateTimeOrNull
methods.description: Retrieve a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Check if a parameter exists in the specified parameter bag.
